title: 第一章 低级武徒第二章 家族困境
content_zh:
密室之中，一位少年正盘膝而坐，双目紧闭，在他面前的地面上摆放着两支瓷瓶。
少年的身上有淡淡的白气环绕，地面上刻画的符文也闪动着灵光，显然这里存在着一座法阵。
而少年正好处于法阵的中心位置，看样子是在借助阵法之力进行修炼。
突然，少年抓起面前的一个瓷瓶，从中倒出一些乳白色的液体进入口中。
随着液体下肚，少年也不似之前那么平静，身体开始微微颤抖，好像正在承受着巨大的痛苦。
但少年愣是咬紧牙关，没有发出一丝声响。
身上的青筋也在药力的作用下慢慢鼓起，就像一条条蠕动的蚯蚓一般。
大约十息后，少年再次睁开双眼，此时的他全身已经被汗水浸透。
但他没时间管这些，毫不犹豫的抓起另一个瓷瓶，从中倒出一粒丹药吞入腹中。
随手将瓷瓶扔出，少年就再次闭上双眼，专心吸收丹药溢散的能量。
就这样持续了一刻钟后，少年猛地睁开双眼，大喝一声
“给我破...”
“啵”
体内好像有什么碎裂一样，少年随之全身放松下来，瘫坐在地上，不断喘着粗气。
“终于突破到低级武徒境界了，不过淬体液果然跟传闻中一样，服下后全体巨痛无比，差点就没坚持住”
少年呲牙咧嘴的活动了下因为疼痛有些麻木的身体，然后感觉到丹田中鸽子蛋大小的真气气团又嘿嘿的傻笑起来。
少年名叫柳辰，是元南郡郡主之子，可以说整个郡一城两县十一镇全都是他家的，因为整个郡地本来就是他家的封地，柳家的话在这里比王国的王室还要好使。
柳家能掌管这么大的一片领地而无事，是因为柳家拥有这个世界主导性的力量—“武者”
柳家也是一个武者世家，家传的“沐阳决”
保证着柳家武者不会断绝，再加上整个郡资源的加持，使得柳家高端战力的不缺。

刚刚柳辰就是在使用“淬体液”
以及“破阶丹”
来突破低级武徒境界，寻常武者能有一种用来突破就算不错了，而柳辰却是两种一起服用，可以说想失败都难，这也是身在武者家族的好处。
有前人的经验可以借鉴，有各种修炼资源可以辅助，比一些散人突破境界要容易的多。
武者可不是随便谁都可以修炼的起的，单单一个入门功法就把大部分人挡在门外，就更不要说修炼需要的海量资源了。
又在阵法上修炼了一刻钟后，阵法的光芒渐渐暗淡了下去，柳辰知道，这是启动阵法的灵石消耗完了。
“五块灵石就这么没有了，还真是不禁使，这聚灵阵也太费灵石了。”
“这还是我境界低只开了低级法阵，要是父亲修炼开启高级法阵岂不是....”
想到这里柳辰倒吸一口凉气，不再管已经停止运行的法阵，起身向密室外面走去。
“据说这法阵每三年还要请王都的修士大人进行维护，这又要一笔费用，还好不是我当家，否则还不心疼死”
content_en:
In the secret room, a young man was sitting cross-legged, his eyes closed, and two porcelain bottles were placed on the ground in front of him.
There is a faint white air surrounding the young man's body, and the runes carved on the ground are also flashing with spiritual light. It is obvious that there is a magic circle here.
The young man happened to be in the center of the formation, and it seemed that he was using the power of the formation to practice.
Suddenly, the boy grabbed a porcelain bottle in front of him and poured some milky white liquid into his mouth.
As the liquid went down, the boy was no longer as calm as before, and his body began to tremble slightly, as if he was suffering from great pain.
But the young man gritted his teeth and didn't make a sound.
The veins on his body slowly swelled under the influence of the medicine, like squirming earthworms.
About ten breaths later, the boy opened his eyes again. By this time, his whole body was soaked with sweat.
But he didn't have time to care about this. He grabbed another porcelain bottle without hesitation, poured out a pill from it and swallowed it.
Throwing the porcelain bottle carelessly, the young man closed his eyes again and concentrated on absorbing the energy escaping from the elixir.
After this continued for a quarter of an hour, the boy suddenly opened his eyes and shouted loudly
"Break it for me..."
"Bo"
As if something was broken inside his body, the young man relaxed his whole body and collapsed on the ground, breathing heavily.
"I finally broke through to the low-level martial arts realm, but the body tempering liquid is exactly as rumored. After taking it, my whole body was in great pain, and I almost couldn't hold on."
The young man grinned and moved his body, which was a little numb due to pain, and then he felt a dove egg-sized ball of true energy in his dantian and giggled again.
The young man's name is Liu Chen, and he is the son of the princess of Yuannan County. It can be said that the entire county, one city, two counties and eleven towns belong to his family, because the entire county is originally his family's fiefdom, and the Liu family's words are more effective here than the royal family of the kingdom.
The reason why the Liu family can control such a large territory without any problems is because the Liu family possesses the world's leading power - "Warrior"
The Liu family is also a family of warriors, and the "Muyang Jue" is passed down from family to family.
It ensures that the Liu family's warriors will not be cut off, and coupled with the blessing of the entire county's resources, the Liu family has no shortage of high-end combat power.
Just now Liu Chen was using "Quenching Liquid"
and "Level Breaking Pill"
To break through the realm of low-level warriors, it would be good for ordinary warriors to have one to use to break through, but Liu Chen takes two together. It can be said that it is difficult to fail. This is also the benefit of being in a family of warriors.
There are previous experiences to draw from and various cultivation resources to assist. It is much easier than some individual people to break through the realm.
Not just anyone can become a martial artist. A single introductory technique can keep most people out, not to mention the massive resources required for cultivation.
After practicing on the formation for another quarter of an hour, the light of the formation gradually dimmed. Liu Chen knew that this was because the spiritual stones that activated the formation were exhausted.
"The five spirit stones are just gone. I really can't help but use it. This spirit gathering formation consumes too many spirit stones."
"This is because I am of a low level and have only opened a low-level magic circle. If my father practices and opens a high-level magic circle, wouldn't it be..."
Thinking of this, Liu Chen took a deep breath, no longer caring about the magic circle that had stopped running, stood up and walked out of the secret room.
"It is said that this magic circle needs to be maintained by the monks from the royal capital every three years. This costs another fee. Fortunately, I am not in charge, otherwise I would be heartbroken."
